_doc: Values the MLCB 2026 author response (2026-08-17, tag mlcb-rebuttal-2026-08-17) gave the reviewers, keyed as reb.<key> for the changes-since-submission appendix. Reconstructed from docs/reviews/mlcb2026/reviews_and_responses.md; the response text itself is not in the repository. Only numbers that appear in the response text itself are kept (the GENA-LM anchored and Enformer values quoted in later internal notes were removed 2026-11-08). Every value here predates the camera-ready recompute and most came from the pipeline the recompute corrected.

t1.what: paired NT-v2 (meanG, test pick) minus CDS 4-mer, macro-F1, 1,000 gene-level resamples

t2.what: paired NT-v2 (meanG) minus AA 2-mer, macro-F1, called an explicit null

gp.aa3-gt-aa2.what: paired AA 3-mer minus AA 2-mer, GenePT R^2

tss-overlap.scored.n.what: test genes whose TSS window overlaps a train or validation window, homology split

gp.encoder-gt-aa3.what: paired DNABERT-2 minus AA 3-mer, GenePT R^2 (the response quoted it as AA 3-mer minus DNABERT-2, +0.014 [+0.007, +0.021])

rr.pooled.what: pooled variance-weighted R^2: ESM-2 / DNABERT-2 / NT-v2 / GENA-LM

tss-overlap.pairs.what: overlapping cross-split TSS window pairs, homology split
